places.name: Paris
places.what: Born in Paris to Adolphe Bizet and Aimée Delsarte. This is a city-level marker, not a pinpoint of the family home.

places.name: Paris Conservatoire
places.what: Enrolled before his tenth birthday; studied piano with Marmontel, organ with Benoist and composition with Fromental Halévy. Marker at the historic Conservatoire site.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, Conservatoire years
Palazzetto Bru Zane — Georges Bizet à Paris, the Conservatoire

places.name: Bouffes-Parisiens, Paris
places.what: First performance of his prize-winning one-act opera; Bizet’s setting alternated with Charles Lecocq’s setting of the same libretto.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet Catalogue: Le Docteur Miracle, performances

places.name: Villa Medici, Rome
places.what: Prix de Rome pensioner at the French Academy; composed Don Procopio and sent it home in place of the expected mass.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, the Roman sojourn

places.name: Anzio
places.what: An excursion in the second year of his Rome residency; city-level marker.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, Italian journeys

places.name: Naples
places.what: Visited southern Italy during his second year at the Villa Medici; city-level marker, without an asserted lodging address.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, Italian journeys

places.name: Pompeii
places.what: Visited Pompeii during the journey that also took him to Naples. Marker at the archaeological site, not a reconstructed itinerary within it.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, Italian journeys

places.name: Venice
places.what: Visited with Ernest Guiraud on his return journey to France; city-level marker.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, departure from Italy

places.name: Le Vésinet
places.what: Spent summers in a cottage built by his father in the mid-1860s and returned during the Commune in 1871. These were intermittent stays; the marker identifies the town rather than a particular cottage.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, 1864–66 and 1871

places.name: Bordeaux
places.what: After the armistice, visited his mother-in-law with Geneviève before returning to Paris. City-level marker.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, the war and armistice

places.name: Compiègne
places.what: One of his places of refuge outside Paris during the Commune; he also stayed at Le Vésinet. City-level marker.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet: Brief Biography, the Commune

places.name: Bougival
places.what: Worked on the orchestration of Carmen beside the Seine. This marker identifies Bougival, not an exact room or manuscript location.

sources.title: Hugh Macdonald — Bizet Catalogue: Carmen, letters of May and August 1874

places.name: Opéra-Comique, Salle Favart, Paris
places.what: First performance, with Célestine Galli-Marié as Carmen and Paul Lhérie as José. The second Salle Favart stood on this site; the present theatre is later.

sources.title: Palazzetto Bru Zane — Carmen: première at Salle Favart II
Hugh Macdonald — Bizet Catalogue: Carmen, first performance

places.name: Bougival
places.what: Died aged thirty-six, during Carmen’s first Paris run. City-level marker.
